title: A Bayesian Vertical Federated Learning Framework for Multivariate Reduced-Rank High-Dimensional Regression
abstract: arXiv:2609.22654v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated learning (FL) has emerged as a leading privacy-preserving framework for collaborative machine learning across decentralized environments. While considerable progress has been made in horizontal federated learning (HFL), where data with common features is distributed across sites, vertical federated learning (VFL), where sites share observations across distinct feature sets, remains less explored. Advancing Bayesian high-dimensional multivariate reduced-rank regression methods for VFL poses unique challenges: (a) stringent privacy regulations preventing local site data sharing, and (b) fitting local regressions overlooks essential modeling aspects like inter-variable correlations. In contrast HFL allows each site to fit a comparable model independently. We present a novel Bayesian VFL framework for multivariate high-dimensional reduced-rank regression, termed BayesVFLReg, which enables precise coefficient estimation while safe

translated_title: 一种用于多变量降秩高维回归的贝叶斯垂直联邦学习框架
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）已成为在去中心化环境中开展协作机器学习的主流隐私保护框架。尽管横向联邦学习（HFL）——即具有共同特征的数据分布在各个站点——已取得长足进展，但垂直联邦学习（VFL）——即各站点在不同特征集上共享相同的观测样本——仍较少被探索。为VFL发展贝叶斯高维多变量降秩回归方法面临独特的挑战：（a）严格的隐私法规阻止本地站点间的数据共享，（b）仅拟合局部回归会忽略变量间相关性等重要建模方面；相比之下，HFL允许每个站点独立地拟合一个可比的模型。我们提出了一种新颖的面向多变量高维降秩回归的贝叶斯VFL框架，称为BayesVFLReg，它能够在保障安全（隐私）的同时实现精确的系数估计……
tldr: 该论文提出了BayesVFLReg，一个面向多变量高维降秩回归的新型贝叶斯垂直联邦学习框架，能够在严格隐私保护下实现精确的系数估计并捕捉变量间的相关性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes BayesVFLReg, a novel Bayesian vertical federated learning framework for multivariate high-dimensional reduced-rank regression that enables precise coefficient estimation under strict privacy constraints while capturing inter-variable correlations.
